description: Cross-asset levels beside a labelled FRED strip of policy rate, 2s10s, CPI/PCE/PPI inflation, credit OAS, net liquidity and lending standards. Reach for it when the question is about rates, inflation or liquidity rather than today's tape.

include_history.description: Include the [unix_seconds, value] history arrays on every quote and indicator. Default false — with them the payload is ~116k chars (the FRED strip's daily series run ~760 points each), far past the 10k-token-per-result warning; the values, asOf stamps, return windows and derived deltas answer macro-context questions without them.

name: get_macro_snapshot
